title: キャンバスは2人のもの

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Seeking the Pearl and I are on our way back from an outing when we hear a lively voice calling out to us.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text: Hey, miss! How about a little miso soup to go with your dinner tonight? This miso paste here blew the socks off of a hundred elite chefs!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It has such a rich aroma! There's no way it doesn't taste fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But… I'm sorry! I would love to buy some, but I'll have to give it a pass today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl usually jumps at the chance to explore new possibilities for miso soup, so I'm puzzled by her response.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: There's something else I want. Could you tag along with me for a little shopping?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Okay, so first we need some daikon radish and cabbage… maybe a little fried tofu too. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: For the broth, let's go with some bonito flakes and kelp! Oh, and we can't forget the star of the show—miso paste!
choice_data_list: Wait, but didn't you just pass up buying miso paste from that vendor?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That wasn't the miso paste I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The miso paste Seeking the Pearl picks isn't anything luxurious or fancy, but rather just some ordinary variety for household use.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Okay, that's everything.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting, Trainer. Well then, go ahead and dig in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl watches me with a serious look on her face. This particular miso soup seems to hold some special significance to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, the flavor isn't anything remarkable. It tastes just like the everyday miso soup you'd eat at home. It's almost bizarre how, well, normal it is.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. You look confused.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I get it now! The answer is to pair them like cheese and crackers instead of forcing them together like chocolate milk!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I never imagined that taking a step back could broaden my horizons and reveal so many possibilities! It's all thanks to you for stopping me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Today's miso soup is a statement from me to you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And that intent is that I want to etch out a future with you that's just like this miso soup.
choice_data_list: What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This plain miso soup is just like the future. It's a blank canvas, full of possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Do we want to improve its taste, or increase its nutritional value? There are so many countless things we could do to it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: How should we prepare it? What ingredients should we use? Because nothing about it has been decided, we can do whatever welike!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The future's the same! Numerous choices are right there before our eyes, ripe for the picking!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That the kind of future I want to forge together with you—one overflowing with possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: With you by my side, I can accomplish feats that will turn the world upside down!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: With you by my side, I can carve my name into racing history and create a legend that will be talked about until the end of time!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I feel like I can accomplish anything if I'm with you—the person who helped me realize the possibilities inherent within miso soup!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Together, we can do anything!
Yeah! Together, we can do anything!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Tell me, Trainer, what kind of future do you envisage us having?
choice_data_list: A future where we keep tackling new challenges!
One where we can keep laughing forever.
The only thing I'm sure of is that you'll be there beside me.
The only thing I'm sure of is that you'll be there beside me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Tell me, Trainer, what kind of future do you envisage us having?
choice_data_list: A future where we keep tackling new challenges!
One where we can keep laughing forever.
The only thing I'm sure of is that you'll be there beside me.
The only thing I'm sure of is that you'll be there beside me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, right. We don't need a finish line.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Even after we've achieved our goals and dreams, there will still be endless possibilities ahead!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We can't just sit around and watch them pass us by!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: No matter the distance, let's keep pushing forward! You and I—together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A future full of challenges won't be an easy ride. But as long as we're together, I know that we'll find a path forward!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! What a splendid and lively future!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Laughter can fill you with energy and has the power to draw out new possibilities from you!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Okay then, let's keep laughing together! Let's fill the world with the echoes of our laughter and seize every possibility with our two hands!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of us let our laughter ring out. The day when our voices sweep across the world will surely come!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Gorgeously said! I feel the same!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey, why don't we try to imagine what might await the two of us?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: For instance… Imagine I manage to win first in a never-before-done international race between 100 runners!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It would truly be a monumental achievement for the two of us! You could even say it'd mark the beginning of a new historical era!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The possible futures we discuss become more and more colorful as our ideas keep flowing out. We continue to talk until the sun goes down.
